findings.description: V15 direct crouch and sit renders still show broad fitted shorts under the lifted overskirt. Source-bound ray coverage falls to crouch upper thigh L/R 0.2983/0.2814 and sit 0.1955/0.1853. This diagnostic is geometric evidence only and does not establish fit.

The panel-local two-fold-per-panel field and 4 mm radial amplitude soften the front silhouette, but neutral front/back/profile still lack clearly readable regular pleats; back and right-side panels retain uneven angular faceting and abrupt panel transitions.

V15 all-panel thigh-follow weights reduce overskirt coverage against the posed thighs versus V14; crouch and seated renders lift the hem and expose the shorts over a large area. Current weights are an unapproved deformation hypothesis.
Direct five-view and six-pose review still shows a mostly plain ivory jacket, broad diagonal lavender chest panel, faint elbow channels, and no visible center-back waist adjustment tab.
No authored UV layout exists for the current weighted garment mesh; UV status remains NOT_CREATED.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V15 direct review of panel-local soft knife pleats on four canonical overskirt panels, eight height subdivisions, a 4 mm radial amplitude, all-panel thigh-follow weights and 10.0 cloth stiffness. Front faceting is reduced, but pose coverage regressed and rear/side folds and jacket finish remain deficient.

nextAction: REJECT. Do not repeat V15 all-panel thigh-follow weighting or its soft panel-local radial fold amplitude. Preserve V15 rendered and weight evidence. Next build a skort-style coverage construction by extending the fitted shorts only enough to remain intentionally opaque below the skirt in crouch/sit while retaining the short hem in neutral; add the declared rear waist adjustment tab as source geometry bound to the real avatar surface. Reassess cloth/pose deformation on that changed construction and directly review fresh five-view/six-pose renders. UV remains uncreated and appearance/fit/runtime/release stay blocked.
